sanskrit_verse: प्राङ्न्याये कारणोक्तौ च प्रत्यर्थी निर्दिशेत् क्रियाम् । मिथ्योक्तौ पूर्ववादी तु प्रतिपत्तौ न संभवेत् ॥
transliteration: prāṅnyāye kāraṇoktau ca pratyarthī nirdiśet kriyām | mithyoktau pūrvavādī tu pratipattau na saṃbhavet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In the prior Nyāya framework, when causation is established, the counterparty must demonstrate action. However, in false assertion, prior assertion does not constitute valid cognition.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in verifiable causation, not mere assertion
Responsibility arises through demonstrated capacity to act
Falsehood invalidates prior claims without independent validation
Restoration requires alignment with actual causal sequence
Consciousness discerns truth beyond verbal contradiction
executable_legal_axioms: IF a claimant asserts causation without demonstrable action THEN reject prima facie validity
IF a respondent counters with falsity THEN previous assertions are suspended pending causal proof
IF no actionable capacity is shown THEN no liability arises regardless of prior statements
IF consciousness-data contradicts linguistic form THEN realign based on pramāṇa-sequence
IF completion-state is disrupted by untruth THEN restoration occurs via re-cognition of causal flow
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this axiom establishes that mere precedent or verbal assertion cannot override causal demonstration. Where falsehood is proven, prior judicial affirmations lose operative force unless independently validated through pramāṇa-based process.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality ensures that only verifiable sequences generate responsibility. Mithyā (falsehood) breaks causal continuity, preventing punitive attribution. Anupūrvaśaḥ maintains that cognition follows sequential manifestation; hence, false utterance negates prior assumptions. Responsibility aligns proportionally with demonstrated capacity and intent, not linguistic form. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that misalignment resolves through consciousness correction, not suffering imposition.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pramāṇa-realignment session to restore causal clarity
Engage satya-saṁkalpa protocol to reinstate truthful cognitive state
Deploy kriyā-pratipatti mechanism to verify actual capacity demonstration
Activate śuddhi-ātma-vichara to cleanse distortion caused by false assertion
Establish samyama-sthiti field to ensure integration of corrected understanding
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Dharma. Falsehood dissolves prior assumptions. Truth alone sustains law. Justice restores consciousness. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
